subject: POC scope, success metrics, and activation checklist - Exo Research
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@exoresearch.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery with Exo Research — POC proposal and next steps

Claire — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side and a clear set of next steps so we can get a short pilot running next week if you’re aligned.

Summary of the problem you described
- Current real-time QA pipeline is 2x slower during peak windows; tail latency spikes on long context (>2k tokens).
- Unit inference cost is unpredictable due to bursty traffic and lack of batching/prefix caching.
- Accuracy drift for domain prompts (medical device terminology) — manual QA is expensive.

Business goals you reiterated
- Reduce 95th percentile latency for live endpoint to <= 300ms for 90% of queries.
- Reduce inference cost per 1k queries by ~30% without degrading top-line accuracy.
- Validate a prompt/eval suite to detect regressions in domain answers.

Proposed 4-week POC (high level) — see attached exo_poc_sow.pdf
1) Weeks 0–1: Access + environment setup
   - Service account and read-only S3 bucket for a 10k sample queries file (we'll provide instructions).
   - Network: allow outbound calls to our dedicated staging pool (IP ranges in SOW).
2) Weeks 1–3: Integration + prompt/eval run
   - Deploy model variant tuned for throughput (quantized variant) behind a canary route.
   - Run prompt set (attached prompt_suite_v1.csv) and baseline eval; produce accuracy/latency/cost delta.
3) Week 4: Acceptance + decision
   - Final report with 95th/50th latency, per-prompt accuracy, and cost per 1k tokens.

Success metrics (to be tracked in Redwood Console)
- 95th percentile latency <= 300ms for target traffic (median target: ~120ms).
- Mean cost per 1k queries reduced by >=25% vs your current baseline.
- Automated eval: per-prompt pass rate >= 92% (or show improvement vs baseline).

Owners and primary contacts
- Redwood: Olga Petrov (AM, olga.petrov@redwood.ai) — program owner; Ben Carter (Solutions Eng) — tech lead; Karthik Iyer (infra) — security/network lead.
- Exo: Claire Zhou (Product) — POC sponsor; procurement@exoresearch.com for contracting.

Initial access/setup checklist (items we need from Exo)
- Create a service account with read S3 access and email creds to ben_carter@redwood.ai.
- Short sample set (10k queries) uploaded to s3://exoresearch-redwood/poc-sample.csv (we can accept a shared presigned URL if preferred).
- Whitelist Redwood staging IPs (listed in SOW) or provide VPN access.

Attachments: exo_poc_sow.pdf (POC SOW), prompt_suite_v1.csv (seed prompts + eval rubric)

If this aligns, I’ll loop in Ben to schedule a 30-minute kickoff and share the kickoff agenda. Would Wednesday or Thursday next week work for your team?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Olga Petrov
